parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence and no documented border or facility restriction, so no tier-1 state universal exposure is established. But the dossier documents a recent pattern (45 assaults over two months in the largest city, 2024) of violence against LGBTQ people, with influencers calling for violence, community deaths, and police responses that are slow, ineffective and victim-blaming — tier 2/3 state-tolerated targeting with thin recourse. Trans-feminine people face specifically elevated risk, no anti-discrimination protection exists, a president has promised an anti-LGBT bill, and rights groups underserve trans people. Dated security-force raids against transvestis show the state can be a direct perpetrator. Positives (conduct lawful, no expression offence, a human-rights council statement) are real but weak against the documented pattern and absent remedy.
